parastatals.notes: Confirm this row with the research team. INSTRUMENTS: Act=not located (no parent Act; appears to be a company, so the Companies Act 2013 would apply [unverified]); Rules=not located; Regs=not located (Memorandum and Articles of Association not seen); Notifications=not located (no H&UD GO or incorporation or renaming notice fetched); CrossLaws=not located (state service guarantee, RTI rules and procurement laws not checked for CRUT) | EXEC: not identified. The site has 'Board of Directors' and 'Organization Structure' pages that I did not fetch. Post title, whole-time or part-time status, and whether the same person chairs the board are all unknown. has_chief_executive left null. | DOMAINS: capitalregiontransport.in is the likely official domain. The proof is that the Odisha State Transport Authority page (odishatransport.gov.in/content/Mo-Bus/7, a gov.in page fetched this session) links to it under 'Visit MO Bus Website'. The gov.in page describes CRUT as an H&UD SPV and does not name the domain as CRUT's. The site shows a RTI menu and a Bhubaneswar address. | CONFIRM: (1) Legal form and incorporation: obtain the MCA registration or Articles of Association, and the H&UD GO creating the SPV. (2) Name change from Capital to Comprehensive Region Urban Transport: no official source seen. (3) Executive head (MD/CEO) and board composition: check the board-of-directors page. (4) Annual budget: not checked; look at the RTI/4(1)(b) pages, annual reports or the state budget. (5) Website integrity: the capitalregiontransport.in about page loads gallery images from bdggameworld.info, an unrelated domain, and its metadata shows 2026/10 uploads. This may mean the site was compromised or poorly maintained, so a human should check it. A web.archive.org link also appears on it. (6) Scope: this is a state SPV serving the wider capital region, not a ULG-owned company. Per team notes, treat it as NEEDS REVIEW. (7) Only one gov.in page was fetched, and I did not find an Odisha H&UD department page listing CRUT. (8) The web search limit was reached, so searching was limited.
